prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1197; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision at the intersection in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were traveling when the collision happened?

A: I was driving north on the main road and approaching the intersection with the green light. I had slowed down a bit because traffic was heavier than usual.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came through from the cross street on my right side. I think it had a red light, but I only saw it when it was already in the intersection.

Q: What did you do when you saw it?

A: I tried to brake and turn slightly to the left, but there was not enough time. The front of their car hit the driver's side of mine.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you go to the hospital or see a doctor after the collision?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed my left arm and said I broke my wrist. I have a cast now and I am scheduled to see an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?

A: No, I didn't hit my head. I was shaken up but I stayed conscious the whole time.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about how the accident happened?

A: Only that I had the right of way and I was driving carefully. I have photos of the vehicles and the intersection on my phone that I can send you.

Q: Thank you. I appreciate your cooperation. We will be in touch with next steps.

A: Thank you.
